messages:
mia: Quick design check — updated latency sparkline for the console is in staging. At small widths the gridlines and tick labels feel noisy and VoiceOver reads every tick. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/4523

alex: I noticed that too. Suggestion: reduce minor gridline opacity to 6% and only draw labeled major gridlines at full weight. Keeps visual rhythm without clutter.

sam: Agree. Another idea: semantic gridlines — draw heavier lines at 0ms, median, p95, and maybe a faint baseline. That helps eyeballing without reading every tick.

jordan: Accessibility nit: VoiceOver is reading each tick as "tick, X ms" which is awful. We should provide a concise aria summary and an offscreen data table for screen readers that want details.

mia: Example aria-label we could use: `aria-label="Latency chart. median 120ms; p95 430ms; use keyboard or hover for details"` — short and actionable.

pat-bot: visual-diff-bot: visual change uploaded to staging branch (PR #4523). Preview images attached in the PR.

sam: On smoothing: current default is 0.6 which suppresses short spikes (bad for alerts). Proposal: default to raw series with a smoothed overlay toggle, or a small badge that says "Smoothed" when smoothing is enabled.

alex: For outliers I'd prefer muted dots with a halo + tooltip instead of blowing up the axis. Also consider jittering x positions slightly when many overlap.

mia: Copy tweak: legend currently uses "avg" — maybe change to "mean" or "avg (mean)"? Short but clearer for voiceover.

jordan: For screen readers, ensure the legend is announced as a list: `role=\"list\"` + `aria-label=\"Legend: mean, median, p95\"`. That way it reads once instead of per-item chattiness.

sam: :thumbsup: Can we create two quick mocks (dense vs semantic) and run VoiceOver and NVDA passes? I can coordinate with a11y.

alex: I'll add a chart prop `gridlineMode: \"semantic\" | \"dense\" | \"none\"` so the console can switch modes without code churn. Default in console should be "semantic".

mia: Nice. Next steps: alex to add prop + example, sam to run a11y checks and share recording, jordan to draft the microcopy, I'll update design tokens and spacing. Tagging product: @tess for release notes.

tess: Noted. Prefer we don't flip smoothing default for existing dashboards — keep toggle-only for this deploy.

sam: Sounds good. I'll prototype the semantic gridlines and voiceover-friendly annotations tonight and post screenshots here.

alex: Also adding a small aria-hidden data table export for power users who need raw tick-by-tick values.

mia: Thanks everyone — landing plan looks good. We'll reconvene after the a11y pass.
